comparison.objective: Roll pastry to a uniform 3 mm sheet, versus assembling rigid tooling components.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual level rolling and deformable thickness control; candidate uses rigid groove alignment and force-controlled snap engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Requires thickness uniformity without rolling off the sheet; candidate requires mechanical retention and no damage. Candidate has no numeric force threshold.
comparison.reason: Generic bimanual coordination is the only shared primitive.
